findings.title: playbook-hooks.test.ts: 'should handle hooks that throw without blocking downstream' times out
findings.description: The test at tests/playbook-hooks.test.ts:225 hangs indefinitely, exceeding the 10000ms timeout. The test calls reset() inside an async it() block and never resolves.
findings.reproduce: cd D:/converge && pnpm vitest run tests/playbook-hooks.test.ts
findings.evidence:
Error: Test timed out in 10000ms.
 ❯ tests/playbook-hooks.test.ts:225:3
    225|   it("should handle hooks that throw without blocking downstream", asy…
       |   ^
    226|     reset();

findings.title: --select "epoch-013+" returns no matches despite epoch-013..017 tasks existing
findings.description: The `+` suffix selector yields zero matches on the self-improvement-loop playbook, even though epoch-013 through epoch-017 tasks are present. The selector may not handle the `+` suffix or may be matching against a different namespace.
findings.reproduce: cd D:/converge && node packages/cli/dist/index.js list --playbook self-improvement-loop --select "epoch-013+"

findings.title: run.mode deprecation warning repeated per task (14x in one --dry run)
findings.description: Each task emits its own 'run.mode is deprecated and ignored' warning. For a dry run of 8 tasks, this produces 14 identical warnings, drowning out useful output.
findings.reproduce: cd D:/converge && node packages/cli/dist/index.js run --playbook self-improvement-loop --dry 2>&1 | grep -c 'deprecated'
findings.evidence: 14 deprecation warnings in a single --dry run of 8 tasks
